name: zip2john / rar2john / pdf2john - Protected Archive Hash Extraction
description: Extract password hashes from protected ZIP, RAR, PDF, and other file formats using John the Ripper's *2john utilities. The extracted hash can be cracked with john or hashcat. Essential for CTFs and engagements where password-protected archives contain credentials, keys, or sensitive data.
source: CPTS password attacks module; John the Ripper
notes:
=== ZIP FILES ===
  zip2john protected.zip > zip_hash.txt
  john zip_hash.txt --wordlist=/usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt
  # or hashcat:
  zip2john protected.zip | cut -d: -f2 > hash.txt
  hashcat -m 13600 hash.txt rockyou.txt  # PKZIP (varies by encryption)

=== RAR FILES ===
  rar2john protected.rar > rar_hash.txt
  john rar_hash.txt --wordlist=/usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt
  # hashcat modes: -m 12500 (RAR3-hp), -m 13000 (RAR5)

=== PDF FILES ===
  pdf2john protected.pdf > pdf_hash.txt
  john pdf_hash.txt --wordlist=/usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt
  # hashcat: -m 10400 (PDF 1.1-1.3), -m 10500 (PDF 1.4-1.6), -m 10600 (PDF 1.7)

=== 7Z FILES ===
  7z2john protected.7z > 7z_hash.txt
  john 7z_hash.txt --wordlist=/usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt

=== OTHER FORMATS ===
  ssh2john id_rsa > ssh_hash.txt          # SSH private keys
  keepass2john Database.kdbx > kp_hash.txt  # KeePass databases
  office2john document.docx > doc_hash.txt  # Office documents
  bitlocker2john -i image > bl_hash.txt    # BitLocker volumes
  ethereum2john keystore > eth_hash.txt    # Ethereum wallets

=== SHOW CRACKED ===
  john --show hash.txt

=== WHERE TO FIND PROTECTED FILES ===
- Backup archives on file shares
- Developer workstations (.zip, .7z)
- KeePass databases in user profiles
- Encrypted SSH keys
- Password-protected Office docs

defense.why_it_works: Password-protected archives use reversible encryption that can be brute-forced offline. The *2john tools extract the hash/encrypted header needed for offline cracking.
defense.prerequisites: Access to the protected file; john or hashcat installed.
defense.impact: Access to encrypted archives containing credentials, keys, or sensitive data.
defense.detection: [MITRE T1110.002] File access to encrypted archives; *2john tool execution; john/hashcat processes.
defense.artifacts: Access to protected archive files; hash extraction tool execution in process logs.
defense.splunk_spl:
index=sysmon EventCode=1 (Image="*john*" OR Image="*hashcat*" OR CommandLine="*2john*")
| table _time, User, Image, CommandLine
defense.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 4688 and (NewProcessName contains "john" or CommandLine contains "2john" or NewProcessName contains "hashcat")
| project TimeGenerated, Account, NewProcessName, CommandLine
defense.prevention: Use strong passwords (20+ chars) on archives; use AES-256 encryption; consider certificate-based encryption; monitor access to sensitive archives.

detections.name: Hash extraction or cracking tool execution
detections.logic:
title: Password Hash Extraction or Cracking Tool
status: stable
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: linux
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/john'
      - '/hashcat'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '2john'
      - 'zip2john'
      - 'rar2john'
  condition: selection
level: medium
